timing_measurement.method: Fresh learning_path=None lookup_page(input,page_size=90,mode=declared_mode); elapsed_ms measures full first90 computation or raised failure. Initialization is separate.

limitations: These19 requests are exposed development controls, not representative or untouched language validation.
Failures create selection bias. All-attempt rank observations are retained; no completed-subset aggregate accuracy claim or general improvement rate is made.
